δ.m: Lower case delta (δέλτα), the fourth letter of Greek alphabet. It represented in Ancient Greek a voiced dental plosive: /d/ and in modern Greek a voiced dental fricative: /ð/. It is preceded by γ and followed by ε

n: The letter delta (δέλτα (délta)), the fourth letter of the ancient Greek alphabet.
A digit 10 in the decimal acrophonic numeral system that predated the gematria system. An abbreviation of δέκα (déka, “ten”). Equivalent to the Roman numeral X.
